crossRefs.note: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.

translations.web: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
translations.bsb: You stretched out Your right hand, and the earth swallowed them up.
translations.kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed
translations.asv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, The earth swallowed them.
